description: This file is a C++ source file implementing functionality for comparing and generating reports on ABI (Application Binary Interface) differences between older and newer versions of modules, including types, functions, and symbols. It contains class method definitions for diffing, reporting, and extracting user-defined types, along with internal utility methods for collecting and processing symbol and type data.

classes.name: HeaderAbiDiff
classes.description: A class providing static and instance methods to perform ABI diff analysis, including comparison, extraction, and reporting of ABI differences.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::GenerateCompatibilityReport
methods.description: Generates a report on the compatibility between two ABI dumps by reading dump files, diffing their contents, and exporting the results.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::CompareTUs
methods.description: Compares two translation units (modules), collects type and function differences, and generates a compatibility status report.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::ExtractUserDefinedTypes
methods.description: Extracts user-defined enum and record types from a module, filtering out anonymous types and handling ODR list entries.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::CollectUserDefinedTypes
methods.description: Collects user-defined types from old and new modules, comparing them for differences.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::CollectUserDefinedTypesInternal
methods.description: Template method that performs internal collection and comparison of user-defined types maps.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::CollectDynsymExportables
methods.description: Collects and compares dynamic symbol exportable entities such as functions and global variables, including ELF symbol metadata.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::Collect
methods.description: Generic method to identify added or removed elements (functions, variables, etc.) between old and new sets and report differences.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::CollectElfSymbols
methods.description: Handles the collection and comparison of ELF symbols from old and new sets, reporting added or removed symbols.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::PopulateElfElements
methods.description: Populates report entries for ELF symbols marked as added or removed, considering weak symbols based on configuration.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::PopulateRemovedElements
methods.description: Utility to process and report elements that are present in old but missing in new sets.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::PopulateCommonElements
methods.description: Handles common elements between old and new sets, diffing their details and reporting differences.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::DumpLoneElements
methods.description: Generates report messages for elements unique to either old or new ABI dump, excluding source files and ignored symbols.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff::DumpDiffElements
methods.description: Compares pairs of common elements and reports differences, using diff policies and type mappings.
